caption:
週五晚班繼續防颱，今晚的約先留給平安。🐾🌀

2026/10/23 台北天氣貓｜晚班防颱特別版
📍 台北，台灣
🌡️ 17:00 約 25°C / 今晚低溫 25°C
🌧️ 傍晚至今晚最高降雨機率：100%

依 10/22 午間預報，10/23 晚間至 24 日清晨仍在須留意風雨的時段；實際影響請查看氣象署最新警報與風雨預報，不能把這份前一日預報當作目前實況。風雨還沒穩定，就先不安排非必要外出，也別急著去海邊、溪邊或山區。本貓可以等罐罐，大家也可以等天氣穩定再出門。

🐾 趁風雨尚未增強，收妥陽台盆栽與易掉落物品，檢查門窗。
🐾 備好飲水、手電筒，手機與行動電源先充電，毛孩糧食也別漏掉。
🐾 風雨期間避免非必要外出；不去海邊觀浪，不到溪邊與山區冒險。必要外出留意路樹、招牌與積水。
🐾 停班停課以政府公告為準；若接獲疏散通知，請配合撤離。

我負責喵，你負責平安。曬太陽的約，等風雨過去再赴。💛

📌 颱風預報參考：2026/10/22 午間（Asia/Taipei）；非即時颱風定位。
上述降雨機率是一般天氣預報，不代表颱風侵襲機率或風雨強度。
最新風雨與警戒範圍：https://www.cwa.gov.tw/V8/C/P/Typhoon/TY_WARN.html
停班停課：https://www.dgpa.gov.tw/typh/daily/nds.html

追蹤台北天氣貓，早晚一起看天氣；按個愛心或分享，把防颱提醒送給需要的喵友。❤️

— English pawcast —
Friday evening's priority is safety, with typhoon updates still on duty. 🐾
📍 Taipei, Taiwan
🌡️ Around 17:00: 25°C / Tonight's low 25°C
🌧️ Highest rain chance this evening: 100%

The Oct 22 midday outlook still placed the evening of Oct 23 to early Oct 24 within the period needing attention to wind and rain. Check current CWA warnings and forecasts; yesterday's outlook is not a live observation. Postpone unnecessary trips until conditions are safe, and stay away from the coast, rivers and mountains. If this cat can wait for treats, the outing can wait too.

🐾 Before winds strengthen, secure loose balcony items and check doors and windows.
🐾 Prepare drinking water and a torch, charge your phone and power bank, and include pet food.
🐾 Avoid unnecessary trips during severe weather. Stay away from coasts, rivers and mountains; watch for falling objects and flooding if travel is essential.
🐾 Follow official work/school and evacuation announcements.

I'll bring the meows. You stay safe. Our sunny-window date can wait. 💛
